title: tools/generate_authors.pl: refactor to reduce duplication
description:
* Don't duplicate the "Original Author" and "Acknowledgements" sections from `AUTHORS.src` in `generate_authors.pl`. Instead, copy them from `AUTHORS.src` at runtime. (Also, synchronize the contents of the "Acknowledgements" section between these two copies, since they have diverged.)

* Simplify repetitive I/O code. The added usage of `say` requires Perl 5.10+, which is hopefully not a problem.

commits_data.message:
tools/generate_authors.pl: simplify repeated I/O code

By using the `open` pragma and `say` function, we can get Perl to do the
encoding, decoding and line termination for us.
